conventions.curve: X1(m,n), m | n, parametrises (E,P,Q) with <P,Q> = Z/m x Z/n; defined over Q(zeta_m)
conventions.degree: absolute degree [Q(x):Q] of the closed point x; relative degree = degree / phi(m)
conventions.sporadic: a closed point of degree d is sporadic if the curve has only finitely many closed points of degree <= d
conventions.isolated: P^1-isolated (dim L(x) = 1) and AV-isolated (Bourdon-Ejder-Liu-Odumodu-Viray); finitely many points of degree d implies isolated
conventions.answers: each of 'infinitely many points of degree d', 'sporadic', 'isolated' is yes, no or maybe
conventions.gonality: Q-gonality for m <= 2 (from the Phi^infty results, Derickx-van Hoeij, Abramovich, or Najman's unpublished computations); for m >= 3 only Abramovich's geometric lower bound
